sections.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: Loqma ("we," "us," "our," or "Company") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our food delivery platform, including our website and mobile application (collectively, the "Service").

Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, please do not use our Service. Your use of the Service indicates your acceptance of this Privacy Policy.

subsections.title: Account Registration Information

bullets.title: Full Name
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Customer identification and order personalization — used to address you by name and confirm orders are delivered to the correct person.

bullets.title: Email Address
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Account authentication and communication — used for login, password recovery, order confirmations, and important platform notifications.

bullets.title: Phone Number
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Order delivery coordination and support — allows drivers to contact you for delivery updates and enables our support team to reach you with order-related information.

bullets.title: Password (One-way encrypted)
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Account security — securely hashed and stored to authenticate users and prevent unauthorized account access.

bullets.title: Profile Picture/Avatar
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Profile personalization and restaurant reviews — helps personalize your profile and is displayed alongside any reviews or feedback you leave.

bullets.title: Language Preference
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: User experience localization — enables the platform to display content in your preferred language (English, Dari, or Pashto).

subsections.intro: When you create an account, we collect:

subsections.title: Delivery Address Information

bullets.title: Recipient Name
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Delivery verification — ensures food is delivered to the correct recipient.

bullets.title: Recipient Phone Number
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Driver-customer communication — allows the delivery driver to contact the recipient about delivery arrival time and location.

bullets.title: Complete Address Details
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Order delivery — includes city, area, street name, building number, floor, apartment number — critical for accurate food delivery to your location.

bullets.title: Precise GPS Coordinates
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Real-time tracking and navigation — latitude and longitude data used for accurate mapping, real-time order tracking, and driver navigation.

bullets.title: Delivery Instructions
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Special delivery handling — for gate codes, access instructions, or specific delivery preferences to ensure successful delivery.

subsections.intro: For each delivery address, we collect:

bullets.title: Payment Method
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Payment processing — recorded whether you pay (cash, card, or wallet) for order reconciliation and service optimization.

bullets.title: Transaction ID
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Payment verification and fraud prevention — uniquely identifies each transaction for security and audit purposes.

bullets.title: Order Amounts
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Business operations — subtotal, delivery fees, taxes, discounts, and final total recorded for accounting, analytics, and personalized recommendations.

bullets.title: Tip Amount
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Driver compensation — optional tip information collected and transferred to drivers as appreciation for service.

subsections.title: Location & Device Information

bullets.title: Real-time GPS Location (For Drivers)
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Order tracking and delivery optimization — continuously collected from drivers to enable real-time delivery tracking for customers and route optimization.

bullets.title: Last Login IP Address
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Security monitoring — recorded for fraud detection and account security analysis.

bullets.title: FCM Push Notification Token
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Real-time notifications — enables us to send order updates, promotions, and important notifications to your device.

subsections.intro: We collect location data when enabled:

bullets.title: Order History
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Service improvement and personalization — detailed record of what you order helps us improve recommendations and understand your preferences.

bullets.title: Restaurant Preferences
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Personalized experience — tracks your favorite and frequently ordered restaurants to show relevant recommendations.

bullets.title: Search History
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Platform analytics — helps us understand what foods and restaurants are popular and improve search functionality.

bullets.title: Special Instructions
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Accurate order fulfillment — dietary restrictions, allergies, or special preparation requests are shared with restaurants to ensure safe delivery.

subsections.title: Reviews & Feedback

bullets.title: Service Ratings
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Service quality assessment — ratings for restaurant, food quality, and delivery service help us identify areas for improvement.

bullets.title: Written Reviews & Comments
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Community feedback — detailed reviews help other customers make informed decisions and help restaurants improve service.

bullets.title: Review Images/Photos
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Visual feedback — photos of food and packaging helps other customers and restaurants assess quality.

subsections.intro: When you submit reviews, we collect:

subsections.title: Driver Specific Information (Drivers Only)

bullets.title: National ID & Biometric Data
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Driver verification and fraud prevention — Afghan government ID verified through document capture (front & back photos) to ensure driver legitimacy.

bullets.title: Date of Birth
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Compliance verification — verify driver is of legal working age and cross-reference with national ID.

bullets.title: Vehicle Information
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Route planning and safety — vehicle type, license plate, model, color, and photos recorded for identification and customer safety.

bullets.title: Driver License Details
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Legal compliance — license number, expiry date, and photos verified to ensure authorized operation.

bullets.title: Bank/Mobile Wallet Information
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Driver payment processing — bank account details for salary transfers and mobile wallet for instant payouts.

bullets.title: Continuous GPS Tracking
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Order dispatch and customer safety — real-time location updates tracked while driver is online and delivering orders.

subsections.intro: Delivery drivers provide additional information for verification:

bullets.title: Referral Code & Network
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Referral rewards — tracks referral relationships to credit bonuses and rewards for both referrer and new customer.

bullets.title: Loyalty Points & Wallet Balance
bullets.purpose: PURPOSE: Rewards program — tracks accumulated points, credits, and wallet balance for discounts and incentives.

useCases.title: Service Delivery
useCases.description: Process orders, manage payments, and coordinate deliveries.

useCases.title: Communication
useCases.description: Send order updates, promotional offers, and customer support.

useCases.title: Analytics & Improvement
useCases.description: Understand user behavior, improve features, and personalize experience.

useCases.title: Fraud Prevention
useCases.description: Detect and prevent fraudulent activities and unauthorized access.

useCases.title: Regulatory Compliance
useCases.description: Meet legal requirements and government regulations.

sections.title: 4. Data Security
paragraphs: We implement comprehensive security measures to protect your personal information:
securityBullets: End-to-end encryption for sensitive data transmission
Regular security audits and penetration testing
Restricted access to personal information (staff only as needed)
Secure backups and disaster recovery procedures

retentionCards.title: Active Account Data
retentionCards.body: Maintained while your account is active or for legal requirement duration.

retentionCards.title: Order History
retentionCards.body: Retained for 7 years for tax and legal compliance purposes.

retentionCards.title: Deleted Account Data
retentionCards.body: Deleted after 30 days, subject to legal holds or disputes.

sections.title: 6. Your Privacy Rights

rightsCards.title: Right to Access
rightsCards.body: Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you.

rightsCards.title: Right to Correct
rightsCards.body: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.

rightsCards.title: Right to Delete
rightsCards.body: Request deletion of your personal data (subject to legal requirements).

rightsCards.title: Right to Withdraw
rightsCards.body: Withdraw consent for data processing at any time.

sections.footer: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us through the app.
